notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
New Announcement!

For the players of Endless Apocalypse! We are proud to reveal the release date of the game. I know there have been people wondering about the current status of the game. The first version is fully complete, and undergoing QA tests. We are excited to hear your opinions and feedback.
Thank you for playing the demo; we hope you have enjoyed it.

Endless Apocalypse will release on Sept 22, 2023
